images_seminary_title: The Multi-Scale Component-Tree in the context of histological images
images_seminary_background_paragraph_1: I was invited by the IMAGeS team of the ICube UMR 7357 laboratory to give a talk about my research during a team seminary. The talk took place on the 1st of April 2025 in Illkirch-Graffenstaden, France.
images_seminary_background_paragraph_2: I presented a compilation of the IABM 2024, DGMM 2024, ISBI 2024 and thesis defense talks mostly focused on the Multi-Scale Component-Tree and its potential applications on cell segmentation and classification for Immunohistochemistry images.
